Class GameMap

java.lang.Object
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.game.Maps.GameMap
Direct Known Subclasses:
DeathTrap, DizzyHighway, ExtraCrispy, LostBearings
public abstract class GameMap extends Object
Abstract base class for defining custom game maps in RoboRally. Each map consists of one or more sub-boards, a list of board elements, and an antenna position. Subclasses must implement initializeSubBoards() and initializeElements().

    • initializeBoard

      public void initializeBoard(String boardId, Direction direction)
      Initializes the StartA sub-board with antenna, walls, belts and start positions, depending on the specified orientation (EAST or WEST).
      Parameters:
      boardId - The identifier of the sub-board (usually "StartA").
      direction - The direction the antenna and start points are facing.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the board ID or direction is unsupported.
